description: Paired document bootstrap: 10,000 resamples per corpus/stratum, 128 natural selected-key cases for each of three fixed rank-96 cut fit seeds in exact immediate output space, 24 cases per common/rare stratum for fit-seed-41 full 18-layer suffix KL, and a fresh 64-case rare-only full-model panel. Same cases across cut methods, and same local cases across fit seeds. Bootstrap over documents; fit seeds are not independent documents.
